name: Administrator KPI exception detail form
description: Verifies the exception action opens a dedicated domain form and blocks an incomplete material record.
steps: Open Administrator → Executive Overview → KPI & Alerts
Choose Tinjau exception
Inspect indicator, threshold, evidence, risk, owner, corrective action, due date, reviewer, and lifecycle fields
Submit without the required fields
expected: The dedicated exception form is shown and incomplete material data is rejected.

name: Administrator KPI evidence detail form
description: Verifies the evidence action uses a distinct evidence form with provenance and verification controls.
steps: Open Administrator → Executive Overview → KPI & Alerts
Choose Buka evidence
Inspect evidence source, period, factual description, owner, verifier, verification status, and review fields
Save the evidence record
expected: The evidence-specific form opens and a valid evidence record can be saved.

name: Administrator academic period workflow
description: Verifies an academic period uses domain-specific fields, validates dates, and remains visible after saving.
steps: Open Administrator → Academic ERP → Kalender / Periode
Choose the create-period action
Submit with a required field missing
Enter valid start and end dates and save
Open the saved period
expected: Invalid input is rejected, then a valid academic period is created and its detail can be opened.

name: Administrator curriculum and assessment alignment
description: Verifies curriculum and assessment forms expose traceability between competency, content, learning process, instrument, rubric, result, and review.
steps: Open Administrator → Master Data → Kurikulum
Inspect version, validity period, graduate competency, content scope, and learning objective fields
Open Administrator → Academic ERP → Asesmen / Nilai
Inspect purpose, competency, content scope, instrument, rubric, participant, result, and reviewer
expected: Both domains expose distinct forms with traceability and review controls.

name: Role workspace save and mobile guardrail
description: Verifies a non-admin action form saves a record, keeps it after the workspace rerenders, and remains usable on mobile.
steps: Sign in with the Ahmad Fauzan demo account
Open a personal submenu with an action such as Lihat tugas
Open the form and attempt to save without the primary field
Enter the primary field and save
Navigate away and return to the same submenu
expected: Incomplete submission is blocked, a valid record is created, and the saved record remains visible after returning to the submenu.
